name: ScrollSpy
docs: Marks which section of the page is being read: it watches the sections by id and reports the one in view, so a table of contents or a sticky picture can follow.

props.name: ids
props.docs: ids of the sections, in page order

props.name: offset
props.docs: pixels from the top that count as being in view

svelte.reason: an intersection observer on the page's sections; the page owns the state

react.reason: an intersection observer on the page's sections; the page owns the state
